description: Return annualized volatility (%) for each currency against `base`, with the number of daily returns used. Use to rank stability or find the most volatile currency or pair. Omit `currency` to rank the universe (`sort` stable or volatile); provide one currency or a comma-separated list to compare. Use `analyze_drawdown` for worst peak-to-trough loss and `analyze_safe_haven` for crisis resilience. Defaults: 365-day window, `base` USD, `sort` stable, `universe` liquid, `limit` 10. Returns `{ base, from, to, mode, basis, results[] }`; `volatility` is null when there is too little data. Requires a signed-in connection and the Growth plan or higher; each successful call bills 1 API request.

base.description: Base currency to measure against (3-letter ISO 4217). Defaults to USD.

currency.description: Currency to measure (3-letter ISO 4217), or a comma-separated list to compare. OMIT to RANK the liquid-currency set by stability.

from.description: Window start YYYY-MM-DD (UTC). Defaults to 365 days before `to`.

limit.description: Ranking: how many to return (default 10, max 50).

sort.description: Ranking direction: stable (least volatile first, default) or volatile.

to.description: Window end YYYY-MM-DD (UTC). Defaults to today; a future date clamps to today.

universe.description: Ranking universe: liquid (default, broad set) or majors (USD/EUR/GBP/JPY/CHF/CAD/AUD/NZD). Use majors for 'most volatile major pair'.

name: analyze_volatility
title: Volatility analysis
